title: Implement intermolecular potential and crystal builder
action: Implement the site–site intermolecular potential for potentials A and B using the provided parameters (charges, overlap exp-6, dispersion C/r⁶). Create functions to build the α-N2 and γ-N2 crystal lattices with the correct space group symmetries and molecular orientations. Establish a neighbour list for lattice energy sums.
description: This step codes the intermolecular interactions and the crystal geometries required for lattice dynamics calculations.

title: Perform harmonic lattice dynamics calculations
action: For α-N2 and γ-N2 with both potentials A and B, minimize the lattice energy with respect to the lattice constants (a for α; a and c for γ) at the specified temperature and pressure. Construct and diagonalize the dynamical matrix at the Γ point to obtain phonon frequencies. Compute the cohesion energy for α-N2 as the lattice energy per molecule.
description: This step performs the core physics computation: energy minimisation and phonon spectrum calculation, producing numerical quantities used in the scored artifact.

title: Write harmonic results to JSON
action: Collect the computed lattice constants, cohesion energy, and Γ‑point phonon frequencies for α-N2 and γ-N2 under potentials A and B, and write them to reproduction_results.json following the output contract schema.
description: The scored artifact contains the harmonic lattice constants, cohesion energy, and phonon frequencies that the checker will compare against experimental reference values.
output_schema: A JSON object with top‑level keys 'alpha_N2_harmonic' and 'gamma_N2_harmonic'. Each phase object contains 'potential_A' and 'potential_B' sub-objects. Each potential object contains: 'lattice_constant_a_angstrom' (float), for gamma also 'lattice_constant_c_angstrom' (float), 'cohesion_energy_kJ_per_mol' (float, only for alpha), and 'phonon_frequencies_cm-1' (object mapping mode labels to floats). Mode labels for alpha: ['Eg','Tg1','Tg2','Au','Tu1','Eu','Tu2']; for gamma: ['Eg','B1g','A2g','Eu','B1u'].
